decision.readiness_label: 1 - Diagnosed: Orphan catalog mapped, water bug isolated, PPV stack identified
decision.reason: Audited facts show 460 orphan masters (61.4% of all masters in repo) are completely unreferenced by any MI. M_Master_Toon_Universal carries 57.5% of all MIs (2,414 instances). Broken M_Water_Master_Grand_v6 must be retired in favor of v10_Upgrade to eliminate SM6 compile failures. Quarantine and consolidation onto proven canonical masters is the single highest ROI path to project stability and fast DDC cooks.

phase_1_stubs_quarantine.title: Phase 1: Quarantine & Deprecate 460 Orphan Masters
actions: Catalog all 460 zero-MI orphan masters into Docs/Reports/ORPHAN_MASTERS_REGISTRY_2026-09-28.json
Quarantine dead MooaToon/Advanced/ (14), MooaToon/Asteroids/ (4), and JRPG boilerplate (58)
Retire legacy M_Glitter_WorldAligned in favor of M_Master_Toon_Universal stepped brightness instances
Deprecate dead PPV references in build_ppv_nikkidream.py and apply_post_process_stack_levels.py

phase_2_water_system_convergence.title: Phase 2: Canonical Water Master Consolidation (v10_Upgrade)
actions: Fix PCD3D_SM6 compile failure on M_Water_Master_Grand_v6 (missing ComponentMask input) or redirect references to v10
Lock M_Water_Master_Grand_v10_Upgrade as the Single Source of Truth for all water MIs
Verify water interaction in L_CelestialPond, L_MelusinaMorning, and LV_SeaAbove_Prototype

phase_3_substrate_and_toon_polish.title: Phase 3: Substrate Toon BSDF Polish & MPC Binding
actions: Validate M_Master_Toon_Universal Nikki chain (DreamGrade, RimGlow, Sparkle, IridescenceSheen)
Standardize 7-band stepped MIs (_L70, _L100, _L140) across all World Compiler biomes
Bind orphan rhythm master parameters to MPC_Portfolio_Audio (128 BPM beatgrid) and MPC_MelodiaInk

phase_4_headless_verification.title: Phase 4: Headless Shader Cook & Multi-Level Render Verification
actions: Run headless shader cook check with -nullRHI to ensure 0 compile warnings across active masters
Capture contact sheet plates across showcase environments to confirm no visual regressions
